component.name: CS2 Server Blocker
component.summary: Block CS2 datacenters from an interactive world map

description.p: CS2 Server Blocker gives Linux players a native way to choose which Counter-Strike 2 Steam Datagram Relay regions may answer matchmaking. It blocks only UDP traffic to the selected SDR relays; ICMP and normal browsing traffic stay reachable.

Pick datacenters on the world map or in the country list, apply the selection, and inspect ICMP latency and live per-datacenter drop counters. Selections can be paused without losing them, saved as presets, and reapplied at boot.

ul.li: Interactive, zoomable map of Valve's SDR datacenters
Per-POP block/allow selection, allow-only lists, and region-wide actions
Visibility into relay addresses, ports, latency, and drops

screenshot.caption: The interactive datacenter map and Datacenters sidebar

description.p: Theme-aware colors, native alert dialogs, AppStream metadata, shell completions, signed release artifacts, and expanded firewall integration tests.
Added pause and resume while preserving the saved selection.
